description: This file defines the 'Node' class used in Twig's Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) representation, including methods for managing child nodes, attributes, and source context.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the Twig AST, supporting child nodes, attributes, and source context management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Node with child nodes, attributes, and line number, with deprecation notices for direct instantiation.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the node, including tag, attributes, and child nodes.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Uses a Twig Compiler to compile the node and its children.

methods.name: getTemplateLine
methods.description: Returns the line number associated with this node.

methods.name: getNodeTag
methods.description: Returns the tag associated with this node, if any.

methods.name: setNodeTag
methods.description: Sets the tag for the node; can only be set once.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a specific attribute exists.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an attribute, with optional deprecation triggers.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets an attribute's value, with optional deprecation triggers.

methods.name: deprecateAttribute
methods.description: Marks an attribute as deprecated, with a deprecation policy.

methods.name: removeAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute.

methods.name: hasNode
methods.description: Checks if a child node exists by name.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Retrieves a child node by name, with deprecation handling.

methods.name: setNode
methods.description: Sets a child node by name, with deprecation handling.

methods.name: removeNode
methods.description: Removes a child node by name.

methods.name: deprecateNode
methods.description: Marks a node as deprecated.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of child nodes.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the child nodes.

methods.name: getTemplateName
methods.description: Returns the template name from the source context, if available.

methods.name: setSourceContext
methods.description: Sets the source context and propagates it to all child nodes.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Gets the source context, if set.
